rules.name: Keep primitives reusable
rules.statement: Tokens and components may serve the public site and admin console but must not absorb either host's routes, data access, or business logic.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Preserve token ownership
rules.statement: Change the canonical CSS and TypeScript token sources, then rebuild exported CSS and package artifacts instead of editing `dist/`.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Treat exports as consumer contracts
rules.statement: Review public exports, CSS entry points, peer dependencies, and accessible behavior before changing a primitive.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Run package gates
rules.statement: Use `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` for affected code and output.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.

rules.name: Keep Claude Design sync interactive
rules.statement: Use the documented skill only after local verification; do not move credentials or interactive approval into CI.
rules.rationale: This repository-owned constraint preserves its established architecture and delivery contract.
